texts.greeting: Hello! /catalog shows products, /add ID [qty] puts one in the cart, /cart shows it, /checkout orders, /clear empties the cart.
texts.cart_full: The cart is full. Send /checkout or /remove ID.
texts.not_in_cart: This product is not in your cart.
texts.bad_phone: Please send a phone number (9 to 15 digits).
texts.ask_comment: Comment for the order (delivery address, size...)? Write '-' if none.
texts.confirm: Send 'yes' to place the order, or /cancel.
texts.ordered: Thank you! Order {order_id} is accepted. The manager will contact you. Payment is arranged with the manager.
texts.save_failed: Sorry, the order could not be saved. Please send 'yes' again in a minute.
